newsitem.title: UK: UK's Mercury cuts international call rates.
newsitem.headline: UK's Mercury cuts international call rates.

text.p: Britain's Mercury Communications said on Monday it was cutting the cost of international calls to more than 25 destinations for most of its residential and small business customers.
Mercury, the UK subsidiary of Cable & Wireless, said the new rates would take effect from February 19.

Customers signed up to Mercury's residential SmartCall package will pay up to 18 percent less for their international calls while small businesses on the GlobalLink scheme will pay up to 28 percent less when calling abroad.
However, Mercury is increasing the cost of calls to the One2One and Orange mobile networks. It said this followed an increase in interconnect charges levied by the two operators.
One2One is a joint venture between Mercury parent Cable & Wireless and US West.
